en.t: But he could not afford to be careless.

units.source_text: 要尽可能在天黑以前干完。

en.t: He had to finish as much as possible before dark.

units.source_text: 他眯细了眼睛，在融化的玻璃似的热气笼罩下，目测着波浪起伏的沙壁。

en.t: He narrowed his eyes and, under heat like molten glass, gauged by sight the undulating wall of sand.

units.source_text: 每次看都觉得它像是又增高了。

en.t: Each time he looked, it seemed to have grown higher again.

units.source_text: 但是，自己并非违背自然把舒缓的斜坡弄成陡坡，只是把陡峭的斜坡弄成舒缓的就行了。

en.t: But he was not going against nature by turning a gentle slope into a steep one; he only had to turn a steep slope into a gentler one.

units.source_text: 没有什么可犹豫徘徊的。

en.t: There was nothing to hesitate over or waver about.
